newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel stable, trade inactive.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel stable, trade inactive.

text.p: NWE jet fuel remained shrouded in post-holiday lethargy on Monday with premiums stable to slightly higher, traders said.
"The action has been all on the screen today," a trader said, referring to steep late gains in futures markets.
Jan IPE gas oil futures at 1708 GMT were trading at $4 a tonne higher at $231.50 a tonne on strong NYMEX heating oil.
Cargo premiums were unchanged at Jan IPE +$29/30 cif. Barges were around Jan IPE +$27/28, unchanged to slightly firmer. Non-EU material in the Med was around cif high quotes +$4.5/$5.
